craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. Comma→dash (grasping held, whither released). Rejected: 'fuddled' for 'wine-mad' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Fisted, thou art grasped; eyed, thou art spied — whither from us?'
so wine-mad on love-sap, the blest course the Thicket-locked.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim

reads_against.argmap: 'Seized by fist you are, seen you are — where go you from us?' — thus. → Devotion-puffed blessed seize and chase Dhūrjaṭi.
c1_essence: Beyond verse, formula, chant, bright, farther: deep-fair knowable.

l2.plain_english: 'Caught in our fist, caught in our sight — where will you slip from us?' — so, drunk on love's sap, the lucky sprint for the Matted One.
